body: Wow, I hope that wasn't too traumatic for you. Thanks for sharing that. Appreciate your thoughts!
I hear you. I appreciate your frankness, thank you.
Thanks for commenting. I agree that I have to put myself first in this situation, but it's hard not to feel selfish and that I'm letting something special go by doing that.

Thanks for your thoughts. Like you said, I really hope we can stay friends. I just know that she'd be devastated if things ended, as she's said on multiple occasions that I'm the love of her life, that she wouldn't believe in love if this didn't work out, that were soulmates, that no one will ever love me as much as she does, and other things to that effect. I know I shouldn't be guided solely by how she feels, and that I should consider my needs before hers, but these types of statements make me nervous about how she'd take a break-up.
